Title: Visit Sauce Demo shopify store
Steps: 1. Open browser and navigate to https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/
Expected Result: Homepage loads successfully with featured products displayed

Title: Click into Grey Jacket product
Steps: 1. Locate and click on the 'Grey jacket' product card/link
Expected Result: User is redirected to the Grey Jacket product detail page showing price (£55.00)

Title: Add Grey Jacket into cart
Preconditions: User is on the Grey Jacket product detail page
Steps: 1. Locate and click the 'Add to cart' / purchase button
Expected Result: Grey Jacket is successfully added to the cart

Title: Navigate to Checkout page
Preconditions: User has added Grey Jacket to cart
Steps: 1. Click on 'Check Out' or 'My Cart' link\n2. Proceed to checkout page
Expected Result: Checkout page is displayed with payment details and Grey Jacket item present

Title: Verify payment gateway processing with external processor
Steps: 1. Submit payment details via external third-party payment gateway
Expected Result: Payment transaction processed securely by payment processor API
